newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA GETS TWO NEW DEPUTY MAYORS.
newsitem.headline: RIGA GETS TWO NEW DEPUTY MAYORS.

text.p: Riga city council on Wednesday elected two new deputy mayors, Andris Argalis of the Fatherland and Freedom party and Juris Ritinsh of the Democratic Party Saimnieks.
Argalis got 51 votes in favour and Ritinsh 33, politicians said.
"There is not a serious attitude to foreign investments in Latvia although companies are willing to invest," Argalis told journalists after the vote.
He said two of his ambitions were to build another bridge across the Daugava river and to build four multi-storey garages.
He said he also planned to develop the construction of small private houses in Riga.
